title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ps69: POST /sos returns CREATED but resource already exists
description:
Commit bd90d6b2 changed SosResource.render_put() to render_post() and switched the response code from CHANGED (2.04) to CREATED (2.01).

Per RFC 7252 Section 5.8.1:
- 2.01 Created MUST include Location-Path or Location-Query option(s)
- 2.01 Created is for when a new resource was created by the request

The /sos resource is pre-registered as an ObservableResource — it always exists. Activating SOS via POST updates the state of an existing resource, which should return 2.04 Changed, not 2.01 Created.

Additionally, the response lacks a Location-Path option, which is a MUST per the RFC for 2.01 responses.

File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources.py:393 — SosResource.render_post()
